views.name: matches_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "Match"."id" AS match_id,
  "Match"."league_id" AS league_id,
  "Match"."season" AS season,
  "Match"."date" AS date,
  "Match"."home_team_goal" AS home_team_goal,
  "Match"."away_team_goal" AS away_team_goal
FROM "Match"
views.description: One row per match with key identifiers and score-related columns; useful as the base cohort for season/league scoring and aggregation.

views.name: match_goals_by_league_season
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.league_id AS league_id,
  m.season AS season,
  COUNT(m.match_id) AS match_count,
  SUM(COALESCE(m.home_team_goal,0) + COALESCE(m.away_team_goal,0)) AS total_goals
FROM matches_core m
GROUP BY
  m.league_id,
  m.season
views.description: Aggregated measures: for each league and season, sum of goals across matches and match counts. Exposes raw aggregated metrics to support ranking or further analysis.
counter_examples: Give the name of the league had the most matches in the 2008/2009 season?

views.name: team_attributes_latest_per_team
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ta.team_fifa_api_id,
  ta.team_api_id,
  ta.date,
  ta.buildUpPlaySpeed,
  ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass,
  ta.buildUpPlayPassing,
  ta.defencePressure,
  ta.defenceAggression,
  ta.id AS team_attributes_id
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN (
  SELECT
    team_api_id,
    team_fifa_api_id,
    MAX(date) AS max_date
  FROM Team_Attributes
  GROUP BY team_api_id, team_fifa_api_id
) latest
  ON ta.team_api_id = latest.team_api_id
  AND ta.team_fifa_api_id = latest.team_fifa_api_id
  AND ta.date = latest.max_date
views.description: Latest Team_Attributes row per team_api_id/team_fifa_api_id based on date. Helpful for queries that want the most recent attributes for each team.

views.name: team_yearly_attribute_agg

  MIN(ta.buildUpPlayPassing) AS min_buildUpPlayPassing,

views.name: player_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  p.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  p.birthday AS birthday,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birthday IS NOT NULL AND length(p.birthday) >= 4
    THEN CAST(substr(p.birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS birth_year,
  CASE
    WHEN p.height IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE p.height
  END AS height,
  CASE
    WHEN p.weight IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE p.weight
  END AS weight
FROM Player p
WHERE p.birthday IS NOT NULL
views.description: Canonical player row with stable player identifiers and cleaned demographic attributes (birthday year extracted, null-normalized height/weight). One row per player (Player.player_api_id).

views.name: player_attribute_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(player_api_id, player_api_id) AS player_api_id,
  COALESCE(player_fifa_api_id, player_fifa_api_id) AS player_fifa_api_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heading_accuracy_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL THEN heading_accuracy ELSE 0 END) AS heading_accuracy_sum,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL THEN heading_accuracy ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
         / SUM(CASE WHEN heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  END AS heading_accuracy_avg,
  COUNT(*) AS attribute_record_count
FROM Player_Attributes
GROUP BY player_api_id, player_fifa_api_id
views.description: Aggregated attribute measures per player (supports either player_api_id or player_fifa_api_id as key). Computes counts of non-null heading_accuracy and the sum and average of heading_accuracy, leaving raw measures so callers can apply different aggregation rules.
